title: We destroyed AI. For Good?
summary: Discover AI editorial/outlook video. Argues current AI research is fragmenting into incompatible Lego pieces — skill.md systems, RL with verifiable rewards (math/code), continuous self-learning, memory optimization, MCP/A2A protocols, multi-agent topologies. No unified theory connects them. Calls for a 'Faraday tensor of cognition' — a single unified-intelligence-field equation bridging skill / experience / specialization / expertise / emergence as components of one field. Critiques global corporations (Anthropic etc.) for shipping pieces without a unified system view.
claims: Current AI research is fragmenting into Lego pieces with no unified theory connecting them
Skills + experience + skill-fragments + tool-templates need composition machinery (March 12 2026 study cited as evidence)
Industry needs a 'Faraday tensor of cognition' — a unified-intelligence-field equation
Skill, experience, expertise, emergence are facets of a single unified intelligence field, currently treated as independent
Global corporations (Anthropic) ship pieces (skills, MCP, etc.) but not unified architectures — fragmentation as business model
